question.en: Discuss the role of the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in developing nations.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in developing nations.

modelAnswer.en: IFAD contributes to SDG 1 (No Poverty) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) by investing in rural infrastructure, climate-smart agriculture, and empowering smallholder farmers. It bridges the gap between rural productivity and global food security.
